title: Over 5,200 OFWs in Saudi Arabia receive aid from gov't amid attacks

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—More than 5,200 overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) in Saudi Arabia have received government assistance amid continuing travel disruptions following attacks in the Kingdom, including a deadly strike on Riyadh’s international airport last month, the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) said Monday. As of Nov. 2, the DMW and the Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA) had assisted 5,257 OFWs, providing a total of 6,873 services, including financial assistance to 5,164 workers. The agencies also provided food assistance to 659 OFWs, land transportation assistance to 234, shelter assistance to 231 and medical assistance to 12 individuals, according to the DMW.
